name: parakkat-hr
description: Parakkat HRMS monorepo root. Web app in web/, Supabase backend in web/backend/, native mobile shells in android/ and ios/ (Capacitor).

scripts.android: npm run build:web && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run build:web && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.test: npm --prefix web test && npm --prefix services/attendance test
scripts.test:database: npm --prefix web/backend test && npm --prefix services/attendance run test:reports && npm --prefix services/attendance run test:roles
scripts.verify: npm run test:database && npm test && npm --prefix web run lint && npm run build:web && npm --prefix services/attendance run typecheck && npm --prefix services/attendance run build
